input.quote: 9.8 Any Party shall have the right to review or audit the relevant books, records, vouchers, and accounts of costs pursuant to this Paragraph 9. In affording the right to review or audit, any such Party whose records are being reviewed or audited shall be permitted to recover, from the Party or Parties requesting the review or audit, the entire costs reasonably incurred in complying with the review or audit.
input.rationale: Paragraph 9.8 gives every Party a right to review or audit our Segment S/T cost books and records with no frequency cap, no notice, no auditor independence or confidentiality requirement and no bar on system access, which is walk-away territory. Paragraph 9.9's F&ASC channelling is a procedural gate only. We therefore insert one concise Paragraph 9.10 supplying the complete preferred package (once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, off-site where possible, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, no direct system access, cost-shifting only on underpayment exceeding 5%) rather than rewriting 9.8, preserving the favourable existing cost allocation and the Schedule B proportional recovery byte-for-byte. The clause is mutual, so the same limits operate for our benefit.

ops.text: Any review or audit pursuant to this Paragraph 9 shall be conducted not more than once in any 12 month period, on 30 days' prior written notice, during normal business hours and off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by obligations of confidentiality, and shall not include direct access to the audited Party's systems. The Party or Parties requesting the review or audit shall bear its costs unless the review or audit reveals an underpayment exceeding 5%.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a single paragraph limiting the Paragraph 9 review/audit right to once in any 12 month period on 30 days' prior written notice, during business hours and off-site where possible, conducted by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality and with no direct access to the audited Party's systems, and cost-shifting only where an underpayment exceeds 5%. The right is currently unlimited in frequency, unannounced and unqualified as to access; the clause is mutual so the same limits protect us.
proposal.summary: Insert Paragraph 9.10 imposing once-per-12-months, 30 days' notice, business-hours, off-site, independent confidential auditor, no system access and 5% underpayment cost-shift limits on Paragraph 9 audits.

mappings.element: No more than one audit per 12 months.
Audit at Vendor's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%.
No direct access to Customer systems.
